description: Plays a selectable local notification sound when a VS Code Codex task completes. Unofficial.
configuration.title: Codex Completion Sound
configuration.sound.description: Main Codex task notification sound. Changing this setting plays a preview.
configuration.volume.description: Notification volume from 0 to 100 in 5% steps. This volume is shared by main and subagent sounds.
configuration.subagentEnabled.descriptio: Also play a notification sound when a Codex subagent completes. Disabled by default.
configuration.subagentSound.description: Subagent completion notification sound. Changing this setting plays a preview when subagent sounds are enabled.
